help.temperature: Controls output randomness. 0 = deterministic, 2 = highly random. Recommended: 0~0.3 for precise tasks, 0.7~1.2 for creative writing
help.maxTokens: Only limits the reply length for one response. It does not increase input context capacity. Leave empty for the model default and do not exceed the selected model limit. It is different from the model's total context budget and the separate page_context.page_data byte budget. ~2 tokens per Chinese character
help.topP: Nucleus sampling parameter, works with temperature to control diversity. Usually keep at 1, avoid adjusting both simultaneously
help.welcomeMessage: Shown when this agent is the current target and the user has not sent the first message yet, including sidebar selection, pinned agent, or {'@'} mention
help.suggestedQuestions: Shown before the first message when this agent is the current target. Recommend 3-4 short starter questions, one per line
help.toolBindings: Bind tools the agent can invoke during conversations, each item contains a tool_id field
help.skillBindings: Select skills the agent can use. Skills include knowledge base, HTTP calls, and more
help.skillPackageBindings: Select skill packages the agent can use. Each package contains multiple skills, and the agent will gain all skills within the bound packages
help.inputVariables: Define variables users fill in before starting a conversation, useful for prompt templates
help.contextMaxHistoryMessages: How many recent messages are sent back to the model as context. More history means richer context but higher token cost; this is not the model's total context window
help.contextMaxHistoryTokens: Only limits tokens from history messages sent as context, not the full model input limit. 0 = no separate token cap, message count still applies
help.quotaConversationsPerDay: Max conversations per day for this agent, 0 = unlimited
help.quotaTokensPerDay: Max tokens consumed per day for this agent, 0 = unlimited
help.quotaTokensPerMonth: Max tokens consumed per month for this agent, 0 = unlimited
help.quotaMaxTurns: Max back-and-forth turns per conversation. Exceeded = prompt user to start new chat
help.quotaMaxConcurrent: Max simultaneous active conversations for this agent
help.quotaUserConversationsPerDay: Max conversations per user per day with this agent, 0 = unlimited
help.ragTopK: Number of most relevant document chunks returned per retrieval. Higher = more references but may introduce noise
help.ragScoreThreshold: Results scoring below this threshold are discarded. Higher = stricter, recommended 0.3~0.7
help.ragSearchMode: Vector search for semantic similarity, keyword for exact match, hybrid combines both
help.ragRewriteStrategy: Rewrites user query to improve retrieval. Multi-Query generates multiple search queries, HyDE generates a hypothetical answer for embedding
help.ragContextTokenRatio: Max ratio of total context budget for KB content. E.g., 0.3 = at most 30% of token budget

typeDesc.toolkit:
Python Toolkit: Write a Tools class in the editor below. Each public method is auto-registered as an LLM-callable tool. Supports Valves env config and .zip upload.
Use cases: Call 3rd-party APIs (weather/search/translate), custom business logic, data conversion, etc.
Tip: Method docstrings and :param annotations are shown to the LLM — write clear descriptions.
typeDesc.knowledge_base:
RAG Document Q&A: Link one or more knowledge bases for automatic semantic retrieval and context injection during conversations.
Use cases: Product docs Q&A, internal knowledge search, contract/policy consultation, etc.
Tip: Adjust Top K and score threshold to balance recall and precision.
typeDesc.builtin:
Built-in Tools: System-predefined capabilities like web search, image generation, etc. View the tool list after creation.
Tip: Built-in tools are maintained by the platform and cannot be edited.
typeDesc.http:
HTTP Request: Declarative REST API integration. Just fill in URL, method and parameter templates — no coding needed.
Use cases: Call internal APIs, integrate SaaS services (CRM/ERP), trigger webhooks, etc.
Tip: URL supports {variable} template syntax; configure auth info in Headers.
typeDesc.email:
Email: Let the agent send emails on behalf of users during conversations. Uses platform SMTP config with domain allowlist and recipient limits.
Use cases: Auto customer replies, meeting invitations, notification sending, etc.
Tip: SMTP server must be configured in System Settings first.
typeDesc.code_execution:
Code Execution: Let the agent run Python code in a secure sandbox and return results.
Use cases: Math calculations, data processing, text format conversion, CSV/JSON parsing, etc.
Tip: Code runs in an isolated environment with module allowlist restrictions.
